cohort: Neonates with a mean gestational age of 38.51 +/- 0.89 weeks undergoing delayed cord clamping at 3 minutes.
finding: Delayed Cord Clamping (DCC) does not increase the incidence of hyperbilirubinemia, need for phototherapy, or chance of polycythemia.
mod_finding: There was no significant difference in mean bilirubin level according to mode of delivery.
